rev6.release_notes: This version is digitally signed, so Windows can confirm who published it. Starter machines now remember their machine type and control, and you can set both in Settings > Machine. The simulation now shows the indexable face mill the same way CAD CAM draws it.

cadcam.release_notes: This version is digitally signed, so Windows can confirm who published it. New sketch tools: Project and Include, Spline, Text, and Extend and Break. New posts for Toyoda and Fanuc mills, cutter compensation on every mill post, and Post can now write subprograms. Right-click a part's warning to see what it means or to ignore it. Boring, profiling and hole operations are faster, with many fixes from early testers and new Help pages.
